# routeros_ip_socksify (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Socksify entry.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `connection_timeout` (Number) Number of seconds to wait for a response from the SOCKS5 server or from the destination before the connection is dropped. `0` disables the timeout.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `port` (Number) Local TCP port the Socksify service listens on for the redirected traffic.
- `socks5_password` (String, Sensitive) Password used to authenticate against the upstream SOCKS5 server.
- `socks5_port` (Number) TCP port of the upstream SOCKS5 server.
- `socks5_server` (String) IPv4 address of the upstream SOCKS5 server.
- `socks5_user` (String) User name used to authenticate against the upstream SOCKS5 server.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
